# Pull Request: Add Beyond Compare merge tool configuration

## Summary

This PR adds documentation for configuring [Beyond Compare](https://www.scootersoftware.com/) as a merge tool in chezmoi.  Configuration examples in both TOML and YAML formats are provided.

## Changes

- Added a new section "Use Beyond Compare as the merge tool" to `assets/chezmoi.io/docs/user-guide/tools/merge.md`
- Included configuration examples for both TOML and YAML formats
- Added reference link to Beyond Compare website

## Testing Checklist

I have followed the [contributing guidelines](https://www.chezmoi.io/developer-guide/contributing-changes/) and verified:

- [x] **All tests pass**: Ran `make test` - all tests passed successfully
- [x] **Generated files updated**: Ran `make generate` to ensure all generated files are up to date
- [x] **Code properly formatted**: Ran `make format` to ensure proper formatting
- [x] **Linting checks pass**: Ran `make lint` - verified with:
  - `golangci-lint` - no issues found
  - `editorconfig-checker` - all files pass
- [x] **Documentation builds correctly**: Tested with `uv run task serve-docs` - documentation builds and renders correctly
- [x] **Commit message follows conventional commits**: Used `docs:` prefix as recommended for documentation changes
- [x] **Changes apply cleanly to master**: Branch created from latest master

## Configuration Example

The added configuration for Beyond Compare:

```toml
[merge]
    command = "bcomp"
    args = ["{{ .Destination }}", "{{ .Source }}", "{{ .Target }}", "{{ .Source }}"]
```

This follows the same pattern as the existing merge tool configurations for neovim and VSCode.
